4.desc: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG dealt to enemy targets in the DEF reduction state by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. After the wearer inflicts the DEF reduction state on an enemy target, all allies gain "Comburent" for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s). This effect cannot be stacked. The DMG dealt by ally targets with "Comburent" increases by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>. This effect can be triggered again after the wearer uses an attack.
